notes: Moneyview Darwinbox tenant (published from moneyview.in/careers). The listing is one unfiltered POST /ms/candidateapi/job/alljobs?companyId=main with JSON {"companyId":"main","page":1,"sort_option":"new","limit":10} returning status/data/job_counts (6 rows at review); sort_option=new is the only native control. The rendered allJobs page shows filter groups Sub Department, Employee Type, Job Tag, Country, Experience plus a keyword box ("Search by role, department or location"), all applied client-side over that response. The tenant answers this worker's curl with Cloudflare 403 even for browser-shaped requests, so the listing shape is taken from the project's archived response (companies/moneyview/source/alljobs-page1.json).
